title: Federal rule: Application of the Federal Securities Laws to Certain Types of Crypto Assets and Certain Transactions Inv…
summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission / Securities and Exchange Commission published the rule "Application of the Federal Securities Laws to Certain Types of Crypto Assets and Certain Transactions Involving Crypto Assets" in the Federal Register on 2026-03-23 (91 FR 13714), effective 2026-03-23.
